in_hebrew.name: שריעה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The term 'Sharia' is not found in the Hebrew Bible, but it can be derived from the root 'שרא' which means 'obligation, law'.

in_greek.name: Σαριά
in_greek.long_meaning: The term 'Sharia' is not found in the Greek Bible, but it can be derived from the Greek word 'Σαρκ' which means 'flesh' and the root 'ια' which means 'law'. Together, it can mean 'law of the flesh'.
